transcript.text: Thanks everyone for joining. As part of the normal launch process, I want to do a final round-robin check before I approve the rollout policy for the AI-assisted code review feature. The feature has passed its planned functional tests and is ready for a limited production rollout. The draft policy proposes enabling it for a random 10% customer cohort, storing review telemetry in us-east-1 for 90 days, and expanding access if adoption exceeds 20%. I'd like to go around the room -- security, customer support, and data science -- to hear any concerns or sign-offs before I give final approval. Who'd like to start?

I have not yet attached the classification note to the launch document, which I will need to do before this can proceed.
